scope: lease-expiry recovery after Runtime Worker Team executor owner failure
scenario: Worker A discovers and claims a durable Team task.
Worker A executor fails under controlled injection and Worker A closes.
The claim lease expires without changing the durable task intent.
Worker B discovers and claims the same task with a new lease epoch.
Worker B completes fenced executeTeamTask and the journal reaches finalAccepted.

verification.postgresCleanup: stopped and socket rejected a follow-up connection
verification.transientFailureHandling: one initial PG terminal-wait timing failure isolated and rerun; final full rerun passed

limitations: Failure injection is controlled executor failure, not an OS kill or production deployment restart.
Actor/authorization and operations remain explicit host inputs.
Unknown external side effects and cancellation signal propagation require a later production host audit.
No default desktop Team or autonomous sub-agent activation is claimed.
